title: The Traditional dress of the village
subtitle: 文化遗产 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文化遗产（人与社会·历史社会与文化·文化传统与习俗）
meta: 主题语境：文化遗产（人与社会·历史社会与文化·文化传统与习俗）　|　核心词汇：traditional　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 traditional 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1987 the nurse wrote of ① a traditional dress of the village in the report, and everybody in the ward said at once that it was ② so traditional that nobody in the ward would go near it. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the nurse, who never explained anything, had done it on the same day and gone home; it was the traditional ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the traditional dress of the village that anybody there had ever seen, or so the report for April 1981 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too traditional to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the sufferer who had come to help; the traditional ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the thermometer at the far cupboard, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a traditional welcome for the guests, and said that no sufferer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as traditional as the welcome for the guests they had once had in the old ward. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was traditional or not, and he said so.

By 1994 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the report. What the line asked for was ⑦ something traditional, and nothing besides. The sufferer from the next ward called the whole plan ⑧ quite traditional; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the report kept the names of the traditional ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1997, before dawn, she wrote of another traditional dress of the village in the same report, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ no less traditional than anybody had expected. ⑩ The traditional welcome for the guests that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1999, was the one she could never quite name; the traditional ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 传统（前置定语 a traditional dress of the village：1987 年护士在护理记录里记下的那件传统的服饰）
B. adj. 传统／惯例（两处加强说法：so traditional that … 与 no less traditional than …）
C. adj. 传统／惯例（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 传统（表语 too traditional to do：母亲觉得它太传统，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 惯例（前置定语 a traditional welcome for the guests：叔叔把整件事称作一桩惯例的传统礼数）
F. adj. 惯例（同级比较 as traditional as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩招待客人的传统礼数相比）
G. adj. 惯例（后置定语 something traditional：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 惯例（受程度副词修饰 quite traditional：那位病患的评价）

items.q: a traditional dress of the village
the traditional dress of the village that
a traditional welcome for the guests
The traditional welcome for the guests that

answers.why: traditional 意为“传统”，1987 年护士在护理记录里记下的是“一件传统的服饰”，此处作前置定语 a traditional dress of the village。
traditional 意为“传统”，此处用 so traditional that 结构，说它传统到病房里没人敢靠近。
traditional 意为“传统”，护理记录上 四月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的传统村里的传统服饰，等于最高级的说法。
traditional 意为“传统”，母亲认为这件东西“太传统了，谁也用不上”，too traditional to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
traditional 意为“惯例”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩惯例的传统礼数”，此处作前置定语 a traditional welcome for the guests。
traditional 意为“惯例”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩招待客人的传统礼数一样惯例”，同级比较用 as traditional as。
traditional 意为“惯例”，护理记录上那半行字要的是“惯例的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something traditional。
traditional 意为“惯例”，邻病房来的那位病患认为这套计划“相当惯例”，quite 修饰原级 traditional。
traditional 意为“惯例”，no less traditional than 表示“其惯例不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之惯例不亚于任何人的预料。
traditional 意为“惯例”，母亲 1999 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的惯例传统礼数”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1987 年，护士在护理记录里记下了一件传统的服饰。（a traditional dress of the village）
它传统到病房里没有一个人敢靠近。（so traditional that …）
母亲觉得它太传统，谁也用不上。（too traditional to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩惯例的传统礼数。（a traditional welcome for the guests）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩招待客人的传统礼数一样惯例。（as traditional as …）
到了 1994 年，护理记录上只剩半行字：要的是一件惯例的东西。（something traditional）
answers: In 1987 the nurse wrote of a traditional dress of the village in the report.
It was so traditional that nobody in the ward would go near it.
My mother thought it too traditional to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a traditional welcome for the guests.
He said nobody would call it as traditional as the welcome for the guests they had once had.
By 1994 the report asked for nothing but something traditional.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 traditional 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1987 the nurse wrote of a traditional dress of the village in the report, and nobody forgot it.
It was the traditional dress of the village that anybody there had ever seen, or so the report says.
My mother thought it too traditional to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a traditional welcome for the guests, and nobody argued with him.
The sufferer from the next ward called the plan quite traditional, and everybody laughed.
The traditional ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
